description: This Kotlin source file defines the CategoryRepository class, which acts as a data layer component for fetching content items per category from a network API, with fallback sample data. It manages interactions with the ApiService, handles errors gracefully, and provides a public interface for fetching categorized content for an Android TV app.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class that wraps API calls to fetch categorized content items with error handling.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates a list of sample ContentItem objects used as fallback data when network requests fail.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Public suspend function that fetches a list of ContentItem objects for a given HomeCategory, attempting network request and falling back to sample data on failure.
